annotations.title: Structured data, products and contacts from a page

description: Pull the machine-readable facts from a web page: schema.org JSON-LD and microdata, products with prices, currency, availability and ratings, the organisation's name, logo and address, and contact details (emails, phone numbers, social profiles), plus Open Graph tags. Use for price checks, lead research, building a company profile or reading product pages without parsing HTML. Returns {types, organization, products, contacts, openGraph, jsonLd, microdata}. Errors: 400 bad or private URL. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: extract_structured_data
